title: Bendix employee captured by the Tupamaros in Uruguay

tellings.quote: We had a guy, we lost a guy in Uruguay, uh was captured by the Tupamaros um right out of his office and I believe he was killed.

plain: In the 1970s, an employee of Bendix, an American engineering and aerospace company, was seized from his office in Uruguay by the Tupamaros, a left-wing guerrilla group there, and was probably killed. The author Peter Levenda tells Michels this, saying 'we lost a guy in Uruguay' who was 'captured by the Tupamaros right out of his office and I believe he was killed.'
